I would be content if every pirate and treasure hunter in the galaxy thought the power gems were nothing more than a legend, and therefore not bother to trample across my planet."<br />"Then it might be best if you put the gems back in the Cavern of Screaming Skulls."<br />"Yes, that would discourage anyone from trying to obtain them. You are wise, Jedi.|The Skull Queen and Obi-Wan Kenobi discussing the disposition of the recovered Lost Stars of Nallastia|<ref name="Star Wars Adventures 2: The Cavern of Screaming Skulls">''[[Star Wars Adventures 2: The Cavern of Screaming Skulls]]''</ref>}}
The '''Lost Stars of Nallastia''' were three ancient jewels—[[power gem]]s from [[Margrave Octan]]'s [[Colony ship/Legends|colony ship]], the ''[[Sun Runner]]''—hidden on the [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]] [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]] of [[Nallastia]]. The gems had the power to dissipate [[Force field/Legends|force fields]], rendering impotent [[Starship/Legends|starship]], [[Space station/Legends|space station]], or [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] [[Deflector shield/Legends|defensive shields]].

After the Margrave vanished with the ''Sun Runner'' around [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], it was long rumored that the gems were still with him. In fact, he had left them with his wife, Nallastia, who built the [[Skull Queen's fortress]] and arranged the megalithic [[Trinity Stones]], using the gems only for good. After a gang of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] tried to steal the power gems, however, Nallastia hid all three in the [[Cavern of Screaming Skulls]] within [[Mount Octan]].

Nallastia's deathbed [[Force vision/Legends|prophecy]] of a champion who would one day arrive in the [[Fondor system/Legends|Fondor system]] aboard a [[False Sun Runner|ship]] bearing the ''Sun Runner''{{'s}} markings—one fated to recover the Lost Stars—proved to be the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].

In [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], the Lost Stars—three radiant jewels of variant hue: red, green, and blue—were at last discovered within the [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] [[Moon/Legends|moon's]] Cavern of Screaming Skulls by Obi-Wan Kenobi (with the assistance of the [[Margravine]], [[Quenelle]]), who used their power to dissipate the [[Force field/Legends|energy field]] that held [[Hondu Firewell|innocents]] captive, in a state of suspended animation, between the Trinity Stones.

The Stars, which projected an aura, were later used by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and the [[Skull Queen]] to dissipate the force field from [[Fondor Spaceport]]'s deflector-shield [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|projectors]], thereby allowing them to infiltrate the space station and reclaim it from the criminal starship manufacturer [[Groodo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], whose [[Droid Control Army]] had taken it over and held its denizens hostage. Once Fondor had been [[Fondor Spaceport|liberated]] from the Hutt's destructive machinations by Windu's [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] strike team, the Skull Queen returned the legendary power gems to the Cavern of Screaming Skulls, for the general good of [[Nallastian]]s and "[[outlander]]s" alike.
